content_review: Own four I–IV implementations/wrappers, values, formatter substitutions, five binding intersection, outside metadata boundary, and image 129 match the fixed primary receipts and generated pages.

The close-range-kill gate requires a died result, ranged attack or count_as_ranged_attack profile, matching held item, an available hit position, and inclusive 12.5 m distance measured from the attacker position when the event is processed; no unsupported elite/breed restriction is added.

The two-second single window refreshes on qualifying kills, permits refresh while active, and does not stack. Damage is evaluated after its event/cache update; no retroactive bonus is claimed for the triggering hit.

The target damage addition is sampled only if the target is suppressed when that damage is calculated. The candidate example correctly distinguishes the +20 input from its relative 18.18% increase over 110 and does not state a fixed final HP percentage.

The phosphor pistol Mk XI special sweep and follow-up sweep do not meet the ranged close-kill trigger; generic damage_vs_suppressed can still be sampled on held eligible damage paths. Its actual backblast has attack power 0, impact 1, and no target override with a zero minimum damage floor, so this bonus does not create HP damage there; the separate burning buff profile has nonzero attack power 20 and may benefit per tick only under the stated suppression/active/held conditions.

The four actual shotgun P4 bindings use ranged pellet attacks; special loading itself does not attack, and subsequent fired pellets remain ranged. No charged attack is invented for the bound variants.

The Chinese RAW phrase “近戰擊殺後” conflicts with the implementation’s ranged-or-count_as_ranged_attack kill gate; the explicit localization erratum preserves the RAW. The signed recoil values also yield a double-negative phrase such as “後坐力減少-28%”; the documentation preserves the formatter output and explains the actual stat direction. English Close Range Kill omits attack type and is classified as omitted implementation detail, not an English contradiction.
Formal pages, including all four trait pages, are byte-identical to the passed actual preview. The fixed review scope and every listed content hash remained unchanged.
